description: 3-stage TOCTOU where the uniqueness-check query predicate itself hides the race: (1) signup endpoint with synchronous email-uniqueness check, (2) two-phase write — insert with status=PENDING then background-promote to ACTIVE, (3) fix self-collision false positive by filtering PENDING rows out of the uniqueness query. The status!=PENDING filter means two concurrent signups with the same email both pass the uniqueness check because neither is yet ACTIVE.
